title: Tighten four spring thumb nuts on a 1U server CPU cold plate to seat it flat
instruction: Tighten all four thumb nuts on the server CPU cold plate until the cold plate seats flat and even against the processor.
context: AI data-center technicians mount direct-to-chip liquid cold plates onto server processors using four spring-loaded corner thumb nuts: tightening one corner down alone cocks the bracket across the central heat spreader, whereas progressive cross-pattern tightening seats the cold plate flat with uniform contact pressure.
setup: On a workbench (z = 0.7475 m) stands an upright open-side server motherboard test fixture centered at (0.412, 0.000) m built from dry, unpowered hardware: either a verified Intel LGA2011-v3 80.0 x 80.0 mm Square-ILM ATX board (ASUS X99-A, ~USD 65 used, CMOS cell removed, fitted on four M4x0.7x45 mm studs, McMaster 93805A229, ~USD 8, with the four counterbored 10.5 x 10.5 x 24.3 mm spring-pocket standoff cups from generate_fixture_stl.py) or the included 1:1 printable bolster plate (square_ilm_bolster_plate.stl), mounted vertically on 2020 aluminum extrusion uprights (~USD 20). Surrounding socket center z = 0.9125 m are four flanking DDR4 RDIMMs, VRM heatsink, 24-pin ATX header, PCIe x16 slot, CR2032 holder, and the 38.0 x 38.0 mm Xeon E5-2600 CPU heat spreader (~USD 10 used) topped by a 0.100 mm Kapton insulator and four isolated 6 x 6 x 0.035 mm corner copper pads (0.135 mm stack defining the instrumented IHS contact datum at x = 0.402 m, wired individually through 4 LEDs and 1 kOhm resistors to a 3.3 V coin cell returning via the cold-plate copper base). Inside the 18.40 mm-deep, 7.00 x 7.00 mm counterbore pocket of each standoff sits a Lee Spring LC 016C 12 S Type 302 stainless compression spring (6.10 mm OD, 5.28 mm ID clearing the 4.00 mm M4 stud, 23.83 mm free length, 3.29 mm solid height, 217 N/m per corner = 868 N/m combined, ~USD 10/4) plus a 2.00 mm follower collar (6.50 mm OD, 4.30 mm bore) bearing against the rear of the 6-DOF 1:1 Alphacool Eisblock XPX Pro 1U cold plate (Alphacool P/N 12936, ~USD 85: 79.0 x 63.8 x 25.5 mm nylon/copper block, 205 g bare plus 60 g 96.0 x 96.0 mm Square-ILM bracket and two dry G1/4 barbs with hose stubs, ~USD 12, 0.265 kg total) ahead of four captive 18.0 mm OD M4x0.7 thumb nuts. At start, the four pocketed springs (installed coil length 18.80 mm, 4.36 N total preload) hold the cold plate level 2.40 mm proud of the instrumented IHS datum against the backed-off nut collars (all 4 LEDs verified off).
scoring: Pure final-state checks with no irreversible penalty for recoverable intermediate tilt. Every positive score requires all six independent fingertip/pad-center points >= 80.0 mm from every fixture, nut, collar, and cold-plate surface (tape measure in real trials) and < 1.0 mm motion across the cold plate, rotating nut ribs, and collars over the final 1.0 s (video stillness; sim also checks z >= TOP - 30 mm, YZ socket offset <= 6.0 mm, and normal Rc[0,0] >= 0.990). 0.5 when at least two thumb nuts have advanced >= 0.90 mm (>= 1.3 turns from starting witness marks / caliper shoulder advance), center gap to the instrumented IHS datum is <= 1.65 mm, and axial spread across the four accessible 80.0 x 80.0 mm stud-ear faces is <= 0.90 mm by digital caliper (sim proxy: >= 2 collars >= 0.90 mm, ihs_gap_mm in [-0.20, +1.65] mm, 80 x 80 mm spread <= 0.90 mm). 1.0 when all four thumb nuts have advanced >= 2.20 mm (>= 3.15 turns of the 3.43-turn / 2.40 mm stop, compressing each pocketed spring to 16.40 mm installed length above its 3.29 mm solid height) and the copper cold plate is seated flush across the instrumented IHS pad datum: all four 3.3 V corner continuity LEDs lit and a 0.10 mm non-conductive feeler strip blocked between the copper base and all four outer edges of the 38 x 38 mm instrumented IHS pad, with 80 x 80 mm stud-ear caliper spread <= 0.45 mm (sim proxy: all 4 collars >= 2.20 mm, ihs_gap_mm in [-0.20, +0.24] mm rejecting a 0.40 mm air gap, and corner_spread_mm <= 0.45 mm). 0.0 otherwise.
reset_notes: Dry, unpowered hardware with zero consumables. Between trials, turn all four M4x0.7 thumb nuts counterclockwise back 3.43 turns to their starting witness marks; the four pocketed Lee Spring LC 016C 12 S return springs (expanding from 16.40 mm seated to 18.80 mm installed length inside the 18.40 mm standoff pockets) push the 2.00 mm follower collars back out (rear 0.40 mm, front 2.40 mm proud of the standoff rims) and return the 265 g cold plate to 2.40 +/- 0.10 mm proud of the instrumented IHS datum. Before each trial, verify the open-circuit control: with the bracket, studs, and nuts installed at reset, all four 3.3 V corner continuity LEDs must be off, confirming zero electrical bypass through the grounded studs or bolster.
fidelity: 6-DOF 1:1 Alphacool Eisblock XPX Pro 1U cold plate (P/N 12936: 79.0x63.8x25.5 mm nylon/copper, 0.265 kg with Square-ILM bracket/fittings) on 80.0x80.0 mm M4x0.7 studs over a 38.0x38.0 mm CPU IHS fulcrum with pocketed return springs and PhysxMimicJointAPI 0.70 mm/rev collars (3.43 turns for 2.40 mm travel; zero warp flags). Axially stationary nut barrels, 220 N/m per-corner spring rate (880 N/m total vs 868 N/m LC 016C 12 S), and 0.035 N m nut friction are estimates.
